description: Make a QR code as an SVG file, for a link, any text, or a Wi-Fi network (phones join it by scanning). Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

fileName.description: Name of the SVG file (default qr-code.svg).

level.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30%.

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

text.description: A link or text to encode. Give this or wifi.

wifi.description: A Wi-Fi network to encode. Give this or text.

security.description: Default WPA when there is a password.

name: make_qr_code
title: QR Code Maker
